items.scope: All vulnerabilities on software products that our company provides, including KNIME Analytics Platform, KNIME Server, and KNIME Hub.
AMD branded products and technologies only.
All Cato Networks products and vulnerabilities in third-party products affecting Cato products unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Jaspersoft products and services only.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
SICK AG issues and issues in EHS products (when related to the Endress+Hauser SICK (EHS) joint venture).
Vulnerabilities in AMI firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by AMI that are not covered by another CNA scope.

Vulnerabilities that are discovered, validated, and coordinated through the Hackrate Ethical Hacking Platform, including: software, web applications, APIs, and cloud services; vulnerabilities validated and triaged by our internal security team; and findings disclosed under our coordination that are not in another CNA’s scope.
ASR products only.
Vulnerabilities in all of Insyde Software’s firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by Insyde Software that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All products of 2N Telekomunikace a.s. including end-of-life/end-of-service products.
All Snow Software products.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Microchip Technology products only.
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.
Dell, Dell EMC, and VCE issues only.
NEC issues only.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SBA Research or reported to SBA Research by partner organizations that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.
JetBrains products only.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
WordPress Plugins, Themes, and Core Vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, the Wordfence/Defiant team.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.
Vulnerabilities in Intigriti products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Intigriti that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Toreon that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Kubernetes issues only.
Vulnerabilities discovered by researchers in collaboration with Maritime Hacking Village that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
Pandora FMS, Pandora ITSM, and Pandora RC issues only.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.
Vulnerabilities identified in Wiz products, and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Wiz that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities in software, services, and infrastructure owned and managed by Spartans Security, and vulnerabilities researched and found by Spartans Security in third-party products that are not part of another CNA's scope.
All CrowdStrike products.
All Fortra products and vulnerabilities discovered by Fortra in other products not covered by the scope of another CNA.
Xerox Corporation issues only.
Open Design Alliance products only.
openHarmony issues only.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.

All products of Medtronic or a Medtronic company including supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered in Medtronic products that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Lexmark products only.
